questions.stem: Why does each enzyme work best at a specific pH (its optimum pH)?

options.text: pH has no real effect on enzyme activity
Enzymes only dissolve at their optimum pH
Changes in pH alter the charges on amino acid R groups, affecting the shape of the active site
pH changes the concentration of the substrate

questions.explanation: Changes in pH alter the charges on amino acid R groups in the enzyme, disrupting ionic bonds and hydrogen bonds that maintain the active site shape. This reduces enzyme-substrate binding and activity.
